name: Books
summary: Read ebooks on your phone without a connection
description: Browse your stored books and open them where you left off. Works offline with the keypad and supports books on the removable card.
author: thooton

changes.text: Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
Use common keypad and sizing helpers in existing UI consumers.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Books Source saved on the SD card open instead of saying Not an EPUB.
The page you rest on is saved within 4 seconds, and OK on 'Storage is turned off' opens Books' settings.
Changing a setting keeps your page, finished books stay finished, and notices fit.
Read and write SD card books through Android's grant for the card.
Delete books, convert EPUB to MOBI.
Strip explanatory and instructional text from every app.
